description: Periodic snapshot emitted by mst-projector for one shard (typically one collection NSID). Forward-compatible across Phase 1 (counter-derived snapshotHash + JSON manifest) and Phase 2 (AT-Protocol MST rootCid + CAR file). Readers MUST treat absent `phase` as 1 and prefer `rootCid` over `snapshotHash` when both are present. Per ADR-2605191358 step 5 and ADR-2605191655.

shardKey.description: Collection NSID this snapshot covers. e.g. `com.etzhayyim.murakumo.inferenceJobEvent`.

phase.description: Snapshot scheme version. 1 = JSON manifest + sha-256 hash. 2 = CAR + true MST root CID. Absent ↔ 1 (back-compat).

snapshotHash.description: Phase 1 root identifier: `sha256-<hex>` of canonical-JSON record list. Deprecated when phase=2 emits; dropped in a future cleanup ADR after ≥4 week grace (per ADR-2605191655).

rootCid.description: Phase 2 authoritative root identifier: AT-Protocol MST root CID (v1, dag-cbor). Absent in Phase 1 emissions. Readers SHOULD prefer this when present.

snapshotCid.description: IPFS CID (v1) of the snapshot blob. Phase 1: JSON manifest. Phase 2: CAR v1 file (root + leaf blocks). Optional in Phase 1 emissions if the daemon could not reach the IPFS pin endpoint; required in Phase 2 (per ADR-2605191655).
